oil.when: 2023 (Oil and Filter reminder in the display Settings > Maintenance menu)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Stop the vehicle, set the parking brake and switch the ignition to ON.
Use the controls for the display to reach Settings in the display between the gauges.
Open Maintenance, then Oil and Filter.
Choose the reset option to restart the reminder distance.
oil.note: This reminder is a distance you set yourself, not an oil-life sensor. Match it to the interval in your maintenance schedule.

oil.when: 2018 (OIL item in the trip computer's Setting mode MAINTENANCE menu)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park with the engine running. The Setting mode will not open while you are driving.
Use the trip computer switches to enter Setting mode and open the MAINTENANCE menu.
Select OIL and choose the option to reset the distance. If you also track the filter, do the same under FILTER.
Select BACK to leave the menu.
oil.note: This reminder is a distance you set yourself, not an oil-life sensor. Match it to the interval in your maintenance schedule.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light does not go out right after you add air; it goes out once the system re-reads the tires while driving.
If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2018 and 2023 owner's manuals.
